text: Rolling back a deployment: run the rollback command, then confirm the previous release is serving traffic.
Rotate API keys every 90 days. Store keys in the secrets manager, never in the repository.
The nightly backup job copies the database to object storage and keeps 14 daily snapshots.
Alerts page the on-call engineer when error rate stays above 2 percent for five minutes.
Onboarding checklist for new engineers: laptop setup, repository access, first pull request.
Rate limiting returns HTTP 429 after 100 requests per minute per API token.
Database migrations must be backward compatible so the old release keeps working during a deploy.
Invoices are generated on the first day of each month and emailed as PDF to the billing contact.
Feature flags let us enable a change for a small share of users before a full launch.
Log retention is 30 days for application logs and one year for audit logs.
Customers can export their data as CSV from the account settings page.
Incident reviews are written within three days and shared with the whole team, without blaming people.
Staging mirrors production but uses anonymized data and smaller machines.
Password reset links expire after 30 minutes and can be used once.
Support tickets marked urgent get a first reply within one hour on weekdays.
